purpose: Starting templates for recasting a published search with external tools: MadGraph5_aMC@NLO cards, a Rivet analysis, a Delphes efficiency override, SModelS and MadAnalysis 5 configurations
environment: none declared: MadGraph5_aMC@NLO, Rivet, Delphes, SModelS and MadAnalysis 5 were not installed where these templates were written (E2, 2026-10-08)
status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses; each template stays documented until its tool runs it in a declared environment and a test checks the result against a published cutflow or limit
